banner.title: <1>Words</1> shared across your data
banner.sub: The <1>kinds of data and fields</1> collected automatically from what you have added. The more the names line up, the better questions and comparisons work across datasets.
banner.fixNote: To change the name of a word, open that dataset and use "Revise the design".

map.title: Map of shared words
map.lead: Your datasets' kinds and fields become one map. The more datasets connect, the more this map grows. The band at the bottom holds the world's standard vocabularies — the more lines gather there, the better your data speaks with the world.
map.bandHint: The more lines gather here, the more your words connect with the world
map.unavailable: Couldn't draw the map right now — the datasets' ingest rules could not be read. Wait a moment and reload the page.

schemaError: Couldn't load the list of words. Wait a moment, then press "Reload". If it keeps happening, tell whoever set this server up.

classesCard.title: Words in use right now
classesCard.note1: The number on the right = the count. <1>Kinds count how many things of that kind exist</1>, <3>fields count how often they are used</3>.
classesCard.note2: * Only <1>published (citable) data</1> is counted. Unpublished drafts are not included — they enter the tally once published.
classesCard.emptyAll: There is no published data yet, so there are no words yet. Publish data via "Add data" and it will appear here.

usersCard.title: Datasets using these words
usersCard.empty: No datasets yet. Add a file from "Add data" and it will appear here.
usersCard.draftNote: Once published, its words also appear in the list on the left.

caution.body: The words listed here are shared by several datasets. Renaming one affects search and answers for every dataset that uses it.

known.prov: PROV-O (who made the data, and how)
known.qudt: QUDT (standard words for quantities and units)
known.skos: SKOS (grouping terms and their alternative names)
known.cmso: CMSO (shared words for crystal structure, composition and defects)

overview.toggleAria: Switch how the map is shown
overview.aria: Overview of the dataset kinds and connections
overview.lead: Each circle is a kind, sized by how many there are. The circles in the middle are the connections that tie datasets together. Switch to Detailed to see the fields.

legend.hub: Kind taking part in a connection
legend.size: Circle size = number of items (smallest to largest shown)
legend.hubDataset: Datasets that take part in a link

overview.leadDataset: Each circle is a dataset; its size is the total record count of its kinds. The circles in the middle band are the links that connect datasets. Click a circle to open just the kinds around it.
overview.leadFocus: Showing only what is around your choice, as kind circles. Use "Back to overview" to return.

title: Words
lead: Decide the words your datasets share, starting from a question. A word can answer questions only once a line connects it to datasets or a standard term.

question.titlePlaceholder: e.g. How many records are there for each sample composition?
question.hint: Words are placed to answer this question. A word without a question cannot be created.
question.place: Place the words the answer needs
question.empty: No questions yet. Start by writing what you want to know.

defaultCq.class: How many {{label}} are there in each dataset?
defaultCq.property: How many values of {{label}} are there in each dataset?

question.placedNote: Placed "{{label}}". If the answer needs other words, place them next.
question.standardNote: The standard term is used as it is, so no word was created.
question.notSaved: The question you wrote here is not saved.

term.label: Word (Japanese)
term.standard_first: Look for a standard term first
term.decline: Don't use it, create a new word
term.many_isolated: {{n}} word(s) are not wired yet. They will not appear as question candidates until a line is drawn.
term.removeBlocked: Lines still point to this word. Remove the lines first.
term.exists: A word with the same ID already exists.
term.label_ja_hint: In Japanese. This is the name shown on screen.
term.slug_hint: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (e.g. sample_composition). The same ID means the same word.
term.slug_invalid: The ID must be lowercase ASCII letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
term.cq_hint: Answers are counted from datasets connected by lines. With no line yet, it reads "0 datasets".
term.std_use_note: This standard term can be used as it is, so no word is created. To draw a line between kinds, pick this standard term in the "Lines" section.
term.std_reason_required: Write why you are not using it (kept as a record).
term.list_empty: No words yet. Write a question, or create one here.

lines.brokenHint: The word this line pointed to can no longer be found.
lines.empty: No lines of this kind yet.
lines.lead: Lines drawn between words, datasets and standard terms. Filter them by kind. A line stays as a citable fact and can be withdrawn later.
lines.datasetNone: No dataset can be matched to a standard term yet.
lines.standardLead: Match the kinds and fields a dataset made itself to widely used standard terms.
